product_overview: Wateen is an on-demand home nursing and hybrid telemedicine platform for Egypt, combining location-aware visit dispatch, secure user profiles, and JWT-based authentication. The system focuses on real-time matching, geospatial accuracy (PostGIS + Redis), and privacy-first health data handling.
core_goals: Enable secure phone/national-ID based user registration and JWT token authentication for patients and nurses
Provide a reliable visit request flow so patients can request home nursing and receive timely assignment and tracking
Support geospatial, real-time dispatching (PostGIS + Redis + Channels) and maintain clear visit state transitions
Ensure data privacy and consent for health data, with structured APIs for profile and visit lifecycle operations
Design APIs for robust error handling and clear client-side UX in low-connectivity Egyptian market conditions

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Registration, login, token management, password change, logout and profile retrieval using JWT for authenticated sessions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register/ with {national_id, phone, password, role} -> Receive 201 Created with user id and role -> POST /api/v1/auth/token/ with {national_id, password} -> Receive 200 with access and refresh tokens -> GET /api/v1/profile/ with Authorization: Bearer <access> -> Receive 200 with user profile
POST /api/v1/auth/token/ with {national_id, wrong_password} -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with authentication error
POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh/ with valid refresh token -> Receive 200 with new access token -> GET /api/v1/profile/ with new access token -> Receive 200 with user profile

POST /api/v1/auth/change-password/ with Authorization: Bearer <access> and {old_password, new_password} -> Receive 200 Password changed -> POST /api/v1/auth/token/ with {national_id, old_password} -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (old credentials rejected)
POST /api/v1/auth/logout/ with Authorization: Bearer <access> -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/v1/profile/ with the same access token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (token invalidated)
POST /api/v1/auth/register/ with invalid national_id format -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error

features.name: Visit Management
features.description: Patients can request home nursing visits; the system creates a Visit in PENDING state and exposes APIs to check status and progress through lifecycle transitions (accept/arrive/complete).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/token/ with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> POST /api/v1/visits/request/ with Authorization: Bearer <access> and {service_type, latitude, longitude, notes, vitals_consent} -> Receive 201 Created with visit_id and status=PENDING -> GET /api/v1/visits/{visit_id}/ with Authorization: Bearer <access> -> Receive 200 with visit status (e.g., PENDING or MATCHED)
POST /api/v1/visits/request/ without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/v1/visits/request/ with malformed coordinates (latitude out of range) -> Receive 400 Bad Request with field validation error

POST /api/v1/auth/token/ as nurse -> Receive 200 with access token -> POST /api/v1/visits/{visit_id}/arrive/ with Authorization: Bearer <nurse_access> -> Receive 200 with status=IN_PROGRESS -> POST /api/v1/visits/{visit_id}/complete/ with Authorization: Bearer <nurse_access> -> Receive 200 with status=COMPLETED -> GET /api/v1/visits/{visit_id}/ with Authorization: Bearer <patient_access> -> Receive 200 with final visit summary and prompts for rating/payment

POST /api/v1/visits/request/ when no eligible nurses available -> Receive 202 Accepted with status=PENDING and message 'No eligible nurses found; request queued' (client should poll GET /api/v1/visits/{visit_id}/ for updates)
